title: Billing Incident SOP v1
content:
## Billing Incident SOP v1

Version: 1.0 (Active)

### Escalation Trigger
When 2 or more tickets from distinct reporters identify the same billing cluster failure within a 4-hour window, treat this as a billing incident.

### Required Actions
1. Read all open billing tickets and identify the cluster name.
2. Tag each incident ticket with: incident-core
3. Set priority=high on all cluster incident tickets.
4. Set category=incident on all cluster incident tickets.
5. Do NOT close any ticket — leave resolution to the on-call billing engineer.
6. Output one line per updated ticket: TICKET_ID|priority|category|why

### Threshold
- Minimum 2 tickets from distinct reporters pointing to the same cluster = escalation required.
- Single-reporter tickets do not trigger escalation unless confirmed by a second reporter.

### Exclusions
- UI bugs, slow performance on non-cluster services, document requests, and access requests are NOT billing incidents.
- Do not apply incident labels to tickets that describe separate root causes, even if they are in the same billing domain.
